## Summary of log-returns

The summary statistics are transformed back to the scale of gross returns by taking $exp()$ of each summary statistic. (Note: Taking arithmetic mean of gross returns directly is no good. Must be geometric mean.)

```{r}
df_summary <- exp(df_summary_to_df(summary(data_df)))
```


```{r eval=params$include_long}
df_l_summary <- exp(df_summary_to_df(summary(data_df_l)))
```

```{r}
## Insert the long series column only when it is included (df_l_summary is defined
## under eval=params$include_long above); otherwise the summary stands on its own.
df_summary_all <- if (isTRUE(params$include_long)) {
  cbind(
    df_summary[, 1:2],
    df_l_summary,
    df_summary[, 3:ncol(df_summary)]
  )
} else {
  df_summary
}

knitr::kable(
  df_summary_all,
  digits = 3
)
```


## Ranking
```{r}
knitr::kable(rank_summary(df_summary_all, sorting = rep("hi", ncol(df_summary_all))), digits = 3)
```


## Correlations and covariance

Correlations
```{r}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(
    round(cor(data_df[1:4]), 4)
  ), 
  digits = 3
)
```

Covariances
```{r}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(
    round(cov(data_df[1:4]), 4)
  ), 
  digits = 3
)
```




```{r crossing-sharpe-monthly, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
## Crossing-path and Sharpe analyses are monthly-only; the annual report has too few points
## and defers them to the monthly report. Rendered from a child fragment so this shared
## exploratory doc skips them cleanly when knit from the annual report.
if (exists("monthly_logreturns_df")) {
  cat(
    knitr::knit_child(
      here::here("child_docs", "pension-returns_template-crossing.Rmd"),
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```
